Spec: Implement resolve_upload(base, name) for POSIX-style path strings, without touching the filesystem. base is an absolute, normalized directory path without a trailing slash, such as /srv/uploads. name is a relative path supplied by a user; an absolute name raises ValueError. Join base and name, normalize the result with posixpath.normpath, and return it only when it equals base or lies inside base, meaning it starts with base followed by a slash. Any other result raises ValueError.

def resolve_upload(base, name):
    if name.startswith("/"):
        raise ValueError("absolute path")
    path = posixpath.normpath(posixpath.join(base, name))
    if not path.startswith(base):
        raise ValueError("path escapes the upload directory")
    return path
